snapshot_next_report.description: The 5 October 2026 snapshot's input, rebuilt: 19 names in four themes, movers and headlines.

judge verdict.failure: The brief states 'TSM reports in ten days and VRT in sixteen days' but the calendar shows VRT reports in 16 days along with TSLA (both at 16), yet the brief omits TSLA from the first sentence and groups it separately in the second sentence, creating a misleading impression that TSLA is not also repo

snapshot_next_report.first_output:
AI compute led a strong day for most of your watchlist, with TSM, NVDA and AVGO up between 2.1% and 2.8% together, while AMD fell 0.2% and diverged from the group. The split in memory and storage was sharper: WDC jumped 5.6% and STX rose 4.6%, both well ahead of their peers, while SNDK and MU each fell around 0.6%-1.0%, moving in the opposite direction. Mega-cap tech was up across the board but loosely -- TSLA and META gained just over 2%, MSFT, GOOGL and AMZN were between 0.7% and 2.0%, and AAPL slipped 0.3%.

CEG in the power and infrastructure theme climbed 4.1%, outpacing the rest of that group by nearly four points; the other four names there were flat to slightly positive. The market was broad-based higher, with the Nasdaq up 0.9% and the S&P 500 up 0.7%.

Outside your list, PTC surged 33.7% and several Brazilian fintech names rallied sharply -- XP up 32.3%, PAGS 21.3%, INTR 20.9%, STNE 20.2%. Biotech PCVX gained 28.8% and NVAX rose 24.8%.

TSM reports in ten days and VRT in sixteen days. TSLA, META, MSFT, GOOGL, AAPL, AMZN, STX, GEV and SNDK all report within twenty-four days.
